title: JournalSchema
description: schema.json — inspectable run-directory schema metadata used to admit or migrate a persisted journal.

minimumBinary.description: Earliest Goobers binary known to support the target schema version.

migration.description: Crash-recovery marker for an in-progress forward migration.

to.description: Target schema version for the migration.

version.description: Sentinel indicating that migration recovery is required before admission.
